html:
Dive into the coffee culture of Hanoi with our Hanoi Coffee Tour and learn traditional coffee-making techniques while creating three local favorites: creamy egg coffee, unique salt coffee, and refreshing coconut coffee.

What You Will Do In The Workshop

  • Discover the rich history of Vietnamese coffee and its cultivation across the country.

  • Gain hands-on experience brewing coffee using a phin, the traditional Vietnamese coffee filter.

  • Taste the distinctive flavors of pure Vietnamese coffee, learn how to identify differences among the beans, and recognize high-quality coffee.

  • Master the art of making three iconic Vietnamese coffee drinks: egg coffee, salt coffee, and coconut coffee, while learning the stories behind each recipe.

  • Enjoy the coffee drinks you’ve crafted during the workshop.

  • Receive a Vietnamese coffee filter (phin) and detailed recipes to recreate the delicious drinks at home.

Inclusions

  • All ingredients and tools necessary for the workshop.

  • Bread with condensed milk to accompany the coffee.

  • Coffee recipes (provided as a PDF file).

  • A Vietnamese coffee filter (phin).

  • An English-speaking local guide.

Exclusions

  • Additional food or drinks at the host location.

  • Pick-up and drop-off service.
